tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Ink is near-black (#09090b); Paper is warm off-white (#f9f8f6). The stat grid cells also sit on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on background, card, popover and secondary (≥15.8:1 in both themes). Also the fill of the ink button and the nav monogram.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the API console, email-copy pill, kbd. Most cards use it at 60% (card-glass).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Command menu dialog and toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet filled surface; same value as muted.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, the active nav pill, console tab track, skeleton bars, the Copy tag.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: lead paragraphs, bullets, eyebrows, meta, chips. On background, card and muted: ≥6.3:1 Ink, ≥5.2:1 Paper.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected command-menu item fill.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand hue — mint on Ink, deep jade on Paper. Serif-italic accent words, the primary button, live dots, index numbers, scroll progress, icon glyphs. As small text: 11.9:1 on Ink background, but only 4.20:1 on Paper background (4.46:1 on card) — on Paper keep primary text at 24px+ or medium-weight mono labels; the source ships it this way.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill. Ink: dark on mint, 11.9:1. Paper: white on jade, 4.46:1 — just under 4.5:1; the source's button label is 16px medium, so treat as a known near-miss.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: bg-primary/10 — fill of the 'current' badge, a matched skill tag, the highlighted flow node.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: bg-primary/15 — HTTP method tag in the API console; the contact glow.

tokens.name: primary-line
tokens.usage: border-primary/30–50 — outline of primary-soft items, focus border on the search field.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: cards, chips, section rules, timeline spine, stat grid gaps. Decorative (≈1.3:1), never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: border-foreground/20 — a card or skill tag under hover.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input borders; same as border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, 3px offset, 6px radius, on every focusable element. 11.9:1 on Ink, 4.2:1 on Paper.

tokens.name: card-glass
tokens.usage: bg-card/60 — SpotlightCard, chips' parent cards, outline icon buttons, the search field, skill tags. Lets the grid and glow through.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: bg-foreground/15 — the three window dots of the API console.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: bg-black/80 — the scrim behind the command menu dialog.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 56px blueprint grid behind the hero and contact sections, always masked to fade out.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors only (shadcn layer; unused on the CV). 5.5:1 on Paper; on Ink 4.53:1 on background but 4.30:1 on card — pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive.

tokens.name: syntax-key
tokens.usage: JSON keys and header names in code. 8.9:1 Ink card, 6.7:1 Paper card.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings and header values in code. 11.8:1 Ink card, 5.0:1 Paper card.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers in code and WARN log levels. 10.1:1 on Ink card; only 3.76:1 on Paper card — kept as the source has it; use with a word (WARN) or at 13px+ mono.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The hero name, clamp(3.4rem, 10vw, 7.5rem). One word per line.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The serif-italic second line of the hero, in primary.

styles.name: display-contact
styles.usage: The closing headline, clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 6.5rem).

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: Section titles at md+ (48px at sm, 36px on phones).

styles.name: heading-accent
styles.usage: The last word of a section title: serif italic at 1.08em, in primary.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat grid figures (30px on phones).

styles.name: heading-role
styles.usage: Company names in the timeline; work card titles at sm+.

styles.name: heading-card
styles.usage: Card and degree titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Building the backend APIs behind flight search.
styles.usage: Hero intro, in muted-foreground with the role in foreground.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Built the Xtream REST API that partners use to search and book.
styles.usage: Experience bullets (1.05rem). Lead-in phrase in medium foreground.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy and card descriptions (leading-relaxed in cards).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav links, stat labels, skill tags, footer.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Large pill buttons; nav button uses 14px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE section eyebrows with the index number in primary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE meta labels: periods, contact column heads.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker at a work card's top-right.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips, badges, console tabs, flow nodes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API console body (12.5px on phones).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Code windows inside cards; console status row.

styles.name: monogram
styles.usage: Ghosted degree initials on education cards, muted-foreground at 30%. The nav 'a' monogram is 18px.

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; stat cell padding-x.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; primary button padding-x; timeline indent.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding at sm+; page gutter at sm+; hero text spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Timeline indent at sm+; gaps in the marquee and skills grid.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Space under a SectionHeading; the blueprint grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between timeline roles; contact meta row.

tokens.name: space-28

tokens.name: space-36

tokens.name: radius-3xl

tokens.name: radius-full
